role: New partial supplier for Hamilton Euclidean torus-unfurling endpoint; not a Moise theorem replacement.
assumptions: f is a homeomorphism of R^n
choice: No countable or arbitrary-index choice introduced; all estimates and boundary continuity proved directly.
supplies: Compactly supported isotopy from identity whose endpoint agrees exactly with f on a neighborhood of K; retains actual local PL property if present.

proof_steps.argument: Radial compactification fixed on a ball containing K and f(K).
proof_steps.discharge: Explicit strictly increasing radius function and inverse.

proof_steps.argument: Uniform displacement gives identity extension at the compactifying sphere.
proof_steps.discharge: Explicit bound for normalized directions and radial error; inverse has same bound.

proof_steps.argument: Compactified conjugate equals original f on an open neighborhood.
proof_steps.discharge: Both x and f(x) lie in fixed core of radial map.

proof_steps.argument: Boundary-fixed compactified map is ambient isotopic to identity.
proof_steps.discharge: Alexander scaling formula plus inverse formula and uniform2tL continuity bound.

placement: Root controls placement; proposed as a new draft helper only if Hamilton route retained.
